basic_details.job_title: WCD Janjgir-Champa Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Candidates must be between 21 years and 35 years of age as of 1 January 2026. State government rules apply for age relaxation, but the total age including all relaxations shall not exceed 45 years.

qualification.details: Candidates must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh.

salary_details.office assistant: Level 6, Consolidated fixed monthly salary of Rs. 18420/-
salary_details.details: Allowances for travel during official journeys are payable as per rules when sanctioned by the competent authority.

selection_process: The selection process comprises a weightage-based merit list followed by a skill test or interview.

Weightage of 100 marks for percentage in minimum educational qualification (maximum 60 marks). Additional 02 marks for each year of experience beyond minimum experience (maximum 18 marks). 02 bonus marks for Chhattisgarh native resident applicants. Skill test or interview carrying 20 marks (10 marks each for interview and computer typing/practical skills).
how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application form PDF from the official website.
Fill out the application form clearly in Hindi or English with all required details.
Attach a self-attested or gazetted officer-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form.

Enclose self-attested or gazetted officer-attested copies of all required educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, domicile certificate, and employment exchange registration card.
Enclose a self-addressed extra envelope affixed with a Rs. 10 postal stamp.
Write the name of the post applied for clearly on top of the main envelope.
Send the completed application via registered post, speed post, or courier so that it reaches the office by 05:30 PM on 15 October 2026.
Postal Address: Office of District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, District Janjgir-Champa (Chhattisgarh), Pin - 495668.
important_instructions: Applications must reach the designated office by 15 October 2026 at 05:30 PM; applications received after the deadline will be rejected. Incomplete, unclear, or defective applications will be rejected without prior notice. Employees currently working in government or semi-government institutions must submit their application through proper channel with a No Objection Certificate from their employer. Only full-time experience certificates verified by a gazetted officer will be accepted. Initial appointment is for a period of up to 2 years on contract, extendable annually based on performance and departmental requirements. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination at the District Medical Board, Janjgir-Champa, and submit a fitness certificate within 1 month. The number of vacancies is subject to change.
